home.title: Tabletop Exercise Platform
home.tagline: Bilingual cybersecurity tabletop exercises with multi-framework mapping (OSFI B-13, Law 25, NIST CSF v2.0, PCI DSS v4.0, SOC 2).
home.statusBody: Starter skeleton (phases A and B.5). The database schema and the regulatory control catalogues are in place; the feature screens follow the eight-phase plan in the build brief.

facilitator.name: Facilitator
facilitator.purpose: Runs the exercise, releases injects, controls timing

participant.name: Participant
participant.purpose: Receives injects in their locale, logs decisions

evaluator.name: Evaluator
evaluator.purpose: Read-only live access, scores decisions, records observations

compliance_reviewer.name: Compliance reviewer
compliance_reviewer.purpose: Validates multi-framework mapping accuracy on scenarios pending review

admin.name: Administrator
admin.purpose: Manages users, scenarios, exercise templates, and reviewer assignments
